page: Google Cloud Platform tpu7x-standard-1t is an accelerator-optimized server instance designed for machine learning workloads. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 240.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 4.29 GB of RAM per core. The primary hardware accelerator is a single Google TPU v7x, which provides 192 GB of high-bandwidth video memory (VRAM) dedicated to tensor processing operations.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage or cloud storage buckets. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external networking configurations for public internet access. There is currently no benchmark data available for CPU, memory bandwidth, or LLM inference speeds on this specific instance type.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the tpu7x-standard-1t consolidates a high-capacity TPU accelerator with a substantial 192 GB VRAM allocation, making it a specialized resource for large-scale machine learning tasks. The high VRAM-to-accelerator ratio allows for the deployment of large model architectures. This server is designed for workloads such as deep learning model training, large language model fine-tuning, and high-throughput neural network inference.
